name: Connection
description: A configured connector instance: auth kind, non-secret config and secret handles, shared by many workflows.

global.schema:
enum ConnectionAuthType {
  SECRET_TEXT
  BASIC_AUTH
  CUSTOM_AUTH
  OAUTH2
  OIDC
  NONE
}

enum ConnectionStatus {
  UNCONFIGURED
  OK
  ERROR
  REVOKED
}

type SecretRef {
  id: OID!
  "Matches an auth property name in the connector's config schema."
  name: String!
  "Opaque handle into the host secret provider. Not the secret."
  ref: String!
}

type ConnectionState {
  name: String!
  "Fully-qualified connector id: '@acme/connector-imap#imap'."
  connectorId: String!
  "Activepieces auth kind, so a piece's PieceAuth maps directly."
  authType: ConnectionAuthType!
  "Non-secret configuration, validated against the connector's auth schema."
  config: Unknown!
  "Secret handles; values never appear in state, operations, or the run journal."
  secretRefs: [SecretRef!]!
  status: ConnectionStatus!
  lastCheckedAt: DateTime
  lastError: String
  "Populated by the connector's own metadata call. Display only."
  accountLabel: String
}

operations.name: SET_CONNECTOR
operations.description: Binds the connection to a connector and auth kind; resets status to UNCONFIGURED.
operations.template: Binds the connection to a connector and auth kind; resets status to UNCONFIGURED.

operations.name: SET_ACCOUNT_LABEL
operations.description: Sets or clears the display-only account label.
operations.template: Sets or clears the display-only account label.

operations.name: SET_SECRET_REF
operations.description: Creates or updates a secret handle, keyed by its auth property name.
operations.template: Creates or updates a secret handle, keyed by its auth property name.

operations.name: REMOVE_SECRET_REF

errors.name: SecretRefNotFoundError
errors.description: No secret ref exists with the given id.

modules.name: health
modules.description: Connection health, written by connector checks.

operations.name: RECORD_CHECK_RESULT
operations.description: Records the outcome of a connection check, including revocation.
operations.template: Records the outcome of a connection check, including revocation.
